title: Tool Definitions
summary: This module defines a comprehensive set of tools for AI agents, enabling interactions with web services, data sources, file systems, and external platforms for diverse tasks like web scraping, data retrieval, and automation.

nodes.label: Web Interaction Tools
nodes.title: Web Interaction Tools
nodes.description: Tools for browsing, scraping, and interacting with web pages, including headless browser operations and content extraction.

nodes.label: Search & Research Tools
nodes.title: Search and Research Tools
nodes.description: Tools for performing various types of searches (web, academic, code, local POIs) and conducting in-depth research.

nodes.label: Data Query & Retrieval Tools
nodes.title: Data Query and Retrieval Tools
nodes.description: Tools for querying structured and unstructured data from databases, knowledge bases, and various file formats.

nodes.label: File System Tools
nodes.title: File System Tools
nodes.description: Tools for reading, writing, searching, and managing files and directories.

nodes.label: AI Agent Integration Tools
nodes.title: AI Agent Integration Tools
nodes.description: Tools for invoking other AI agents, integrating with AI platforms, and managing agent workflows.

nodes.label: External API Integrations
nodes.title: External API Integrations
nodes.description: Tools that connect to and leverage various third-party APIs and services for specialized tasks.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation System
nodes.description: Manages the retrieval and augmentation of information for various tools.

nodes.label: External Data Sources
nodes.title: External Data Sources
nodes.description: Various external databases, knowledge bases, and web services providing data.

nodes.label: LLM Vision Capabilities
nodes.title: LLM Vision Capabilities
nodes.description: Leverages the vision models of Large Language Models for image analysis and OCR.

groups.label: Data Access & Manipulation
groups.title: Data Access and Manipulation
groups.description: Tools focused on retrieving, processing, and managing various forms of data, from web content to structured databases and local files.

groups.label: Agent Orchestration & Extension
groups.title: Agent Orchestration and Extension
groups.description: Tools designed to enhance AI agent capabilities through integration with other agents, platforms, and specialized external services.

groups.label: Core Dependencies
groups.title: Core Dependencies
groups.description: Essential external systems and capabilities that underpin the functionality of many tools within this module.
